title: Hausdorff measure of a blow-up inside a ball (scaling of Hⁿ under η_{x,r})
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P, r, R ∈ ℝ with r > 0, and let S ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set. Let η := blowUpMap x r (SimonGMT), η(z) = r⁻¹(z − x), and μ := μHE[n]. Then μ(η(S) ∩ B̄_R(0)) = ((ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹)ⁿ · μ(S ∩ B̄_{rR}(x)), where B̄ denotes closed balls.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (r R : ℝ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < r → μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S ∩ closedBall 0 R) = (ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹ ^ n * μHE[n] (S ∩ closedBall x (r * R))
